UpdateAppBlbServerGroup.sgId: ID of the server group to update
UpdateAppBlbServerGroup.name: Server group name. 1–65 bytes, must start with a letter, allows letters/digits/-\_/. If omitted, auto-generated
UpdateAppBlbServerGroup.desc: Server group description. 0–450 bytes, supports Chinese. Defaults to empty
UpdateAppBlbServerGroup.preserveClientIpEnabled: Whether to enable client IP address preservation. Note: only supported on application-type instances; not supported on application-type IPv6 instances.
